reviews.review:
(This is early access game that is more polished and developed than 90% of full releases that cost 3x as much or more, and gets regular updates and bugfixes.)

One of the best games in my steam library thus far. I have all but one achievement in it and well over 100h. I pretty much got everything there is to get in this game (including the highest level of reincarnation) and I'd recommend it any day even at full price since it's fairly cheap and gets regular updates and fixes.

That being said don't get discouraged in the beginning, the upgrades really help and cat and dog are very much mediocre in comparison to other characters so try them all out before you judge this game. Devs got much better at designing new characters so the newer ones (imo, maybe it's just my playstyle) are more enjoyable and new leveling system is also much better. Devs have my full support and I'm waiting for the new update to dive in for another 50+h or so. Absolutely great game and worth the money. I hope devs will develop this game for years to come even after they finish their roadmap or add a dlc or 2 because I'll absolutely buy it if it's the same quality as the main game. Gameplay and graphics are super unique and very well done, I love how you can take a closer look at every model in the game that is kept in-style.

Tip: Jump around and never stay in one place and don't jump back when you were just a second ago, this and dash will save you most of the time.

Update: 1.0 came out and the game is even better than it was before, lots of good changes to the way health works, a lot more polish, etc. Still maintain my view that devs learned how to make characters that are more fun later on, the new character is awesome. Definitely in the top 5 of my favorite games, well worth the money.
im really love Bandit Hermit fox, no joke but im only play because of this npc ;3
